about: Maintainer-controlled signing-key registry, nothing more. A run signed by a listed key is reported as listed in TRUSTED_KEYS.json; a run signed by any other key still verifies with accessbench verify and scores identically. This file is not a held-out bank, not independent validation, and not a publication gate: no sealed or held-out evaluation bank exists (docs/08-limits.md). Admit a key with accessbench trust add-key; the commit is the record.
